descriptions.zh: 重置成功后，您可以调用[DescribeSpaceClientConfig](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173420.html)接口来查询新生成的服务端私钥。新的密钥对会立即生效，旧的密钥对将会在10分钟内失效。
descriptions.en: After the reset succeeds, you can invoke the [DescribeSpaceClientConfig](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173420.html) API to query the newly generated server private key. The new key pair takes effect immediately, and the legacy key pair becomes invalid within 10 minutes.
